newsitem.title: USA: Ford sees 1996 industry sales at 15.5 mln vehicles.
newsitem.headline: Ford sees 1996 industry sales at 15.5 mln vehicles.

text.p: Ford Motor Co estimates new car and truck sales for the U.S. industry totaled 15.5 million vehicles in 1996, an increase of 400,000 over 1995, Ford Division General Manager Ross Roberts said Monday.
Roberts said Ford, which is expected to announce its 1996 sales later today, sold more than two million trucks last year, more than any other manufacturer in history.
His comments came during a Ford Division news conference at the North American International Auto Show in Detroit.
